note: cookie consent banner -- renders: consent title, privacy/TOS links, Manage preferences/Reject all/Accept all buttons, language selector; operator-configured fixed vocabulary
site masthead -- renders: NYT logo, section navigation links, search button, account/subscribe links; operator's fixed navigation vocabulary
collection section header -- renders: section name heading and fixed sub-section navigation links (Africa/Americas/Asia/etc.); operator's closed vocabulary
highlights section heading -- renders: fixed label like 'Latest'; operator vocabulary
section band header -- renders: section name heading and 'see more' link; operator's fixed vocabulary
tab navigation control -- renders: fixed tab labels for stream switching; operator's closed vocabulary
pagination control -- renders: page number links; operator's fixed navigation vocabulary
site index heading -- renders: 'Site Index' label; operator's fixed vocabulary
site footer -- renders: NYT name and fixed navigation links (Subscribe/Contact/Accessibility/etc.); operator's closed vocabulary
